title: By the statues
goals: Reach the mark, where the corridor goes down.
Do not let Dask see you.
starting_code:
# If Dask looks up, go down two cells with `move_down`.

# Walk right, past Dask, with `move_right`.

# Go down to the mark with `move_down`.
hints: Dask looks up or down. If he looks up, we cannot pass above him.
Look at `dask.facing` with an `if`: the lines inside it have four spaces.
It is four steps right and then three down.
intro: Dask stands between the first two statues, looking up or down. We are against the top wall: if he looks up, we go down two and pass below him; if he looks down, we pass straight along. Then into the corridor that goes down between the second and the third statue.
outro: We passed right beside him! There is a room this way, I can hear the echo.
learned: Now you know that `if` does its lines only when its condition is true.
